title: Protein engineering in Brazil: a biophysical perspective.
authors: de Lima, Mariana Zuliani Theodoro; Umbehaun, Gustavo Foltran; Tomazini, Atilio Jr
one_liner_zh: 系统综述巴西蛋白质工程研究，涵盖结构生物学、计算建模和AI辅助设计，但以领域概览为主，缺乏具体方法创新。
abstract: Protein engineering has become an increasingly interdisciplinary field, integrating molecular biology, structural biology, biophysics, computational modeling, and artificial intelligence to modify protein structure, stability, dynamics, molecular recognition, and catalytic activity. This systematic review examines the historical development and scientific contributions of protein engineering research associated with Brazilian institutions between 1988 and June 2026. A total of 792 peer-reviewed articles were identified in PubMed through eight thematic search strategies covering protein and enzyme engineering, directed evolution, rational and computational design, recombinant protein expression, therapeutic proteins, structural biology, and artificial intelligence-assisted engineering. The reviewed literature reveals a transition from early residue-level mutagenesis and conventional biochemical assays to increasingly integrated experimental and computational approaches. Advances in X-ray crystallography, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), circular dichroism (CD), mass spectrometry, small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), calorimetry, molecular dynamics, and structural bioinformatics enabled the quantitative investigation of protein folding, stability, conformational landscapes, molecular interactions, and catalytic mechanisms. More recently, machine learning, protein language models, AlphaFold-derived structures, and generative approaches have expanded the capacity to predict mutations and design proteins, peptides, antibodies, and enzymes with predefined properties. Overall, protein engineering in Brazil has evolved into a mature and diverse field with applications in health, infectious diseases, agriculture, biotechnology, bioenergy, biomaterials, environmental remediation, and industrial biocatalysis. The findings indicate that biophysics has moved beyond a predominantly descriptive role and has become central to the design and validation of engineered proteins. Future progress will depend on the convergence of experimental biophysics, multiscale simulations, artificial intelligence, high-throughput validation, and stronger national and international research networks.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质工程已日益成为一个跨学科领域，整合了分子生物学、结构生物学、生物物理学、计算建模和人工智能，以修饰蛋白质结构、稳定性、动力学、分子识别和催化活性。本系统综述考察了1988年至2026年6月期间与巴西机构相关的蛋白质工程研究的历史发展及科学贡献。通过八项主题检索策略，在PubMed中识别出共792篇同行评审文章，涵盖蛋白质和酶工程、定向进化、理性及计算设计、重组蛋白表达、治疗性蛋白质、结构生物学和人工智能辅助工程。所综述的文献揭示了一个从早期残基水平突变和常规生化分析向日益整合的实验与计算方法相结合的转变。X射线晶体学、核磁共振（NMR）、圆二色光谱（CD）、质谱、小角X射线散射（SAXS）、量热法、分子动力学和结构生物信息学的进展，使得对蛋白质折叠、稳定性、构象景观、分子相互作用和催化机制的定量研究成为可能。近期，机器学习、蛋白质语言模型、AlphaFold衍生结构及生成方法进一步扩展了预测突变和设计具有预定特性的蛋白质、肽、抗体和酶的能力。总体而言，巴西的蛋白质工程已发展成为一个成熟且多样化的领域，其应用涵盖健康、传染病、农业、生物技术、生物能源、生物材料、环境修复和工业生物催化。研究结果表明，生物物理学已超越其主要的描述性角色，成为工程化蛋白质设计和验证的核心。未来进展将依赖于实验生物物理学、多尺度模拟、人工智能、高通量验证以及更强国家和国际研究网络的融合。
